pronunciation: un · ih · MAJ · ih · nuh · tiv
definition: Lacking originality, creativity, or the ability to form fresh ideas.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
quote: He was a strong-minded man, sir, shrewd, practical, and as unimaginative as I am myself.
example_sentence: The unimaginative sequel was just the first film with louder explosions.
